suite: crop lightbox (launch, zoom, pan on the live crops)
expect_red: what was under the pointer is still under the pointer after the zoom — zooming about the stage's corner walks whatever the reader is looking at off the edge

mutations.contract: `.lightbox__pan` is the one transformed element and its transform-origin is the stage's top-left. The pure layer measures every anchor from that corner, so the origin is not a styling choice -- it is the coordinate system the zoom arithmetic is written in.
mutations.note: The highest-value of the three that issue names, and the reason is the class of claim: this is a STYLESHEET fact, which is exactly what a class-name assertion passes straight through, and the fast tier cannot see it at all. The mutation is the CSS DEFAULT -- `50% 50%` is what the property reverts to if the declaration is dropped in a tidy-up -- and a centred origin offsets every zoom by half the stage, so what the reader was pointing at walks off the edge. Verified in review of crop_lightbox_zoom_viewer (2026-09-17) by planting it in a `git archive` scratch tree: browser 16/17, red on exactly this sub-check.
mutations.find: position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: 0 0; will-change: transform;
mutations.replace: position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: 50% 50%; will-change: transform;
